title: Working on a Substance Painter plugin for AI-assisted texture generation
author: RufatMel
selftext:
I built a Substance Painter plugin that generates textures from text prompts

Hey everyone, I’ve been working on a plugin for Substance 3D Painter called **TexGenesis**.

It lets you generate texture variations from a written prompt directly inside Painter, so instead of jumping between tools and testing ideas manually, you can iterate much faster right in your texturing workflow.

I’ve been testing it on different materials, surfaces, and style directions, and it’s getting close to release. I’m sharing a short video here to show how it works in practice.

What it does:

* generate texture ideas from a prompt
* speed up look development and variation testing
* work directly inside Substance Painter
* help explore directions faster without leaving your workflow
